description.en: Learn festivals and what we do to celebrate.
description.yue: 認識節日，學識過節做咩。

steps.en: New Year: we wear new clothes and say good wishes.
steps.zh: 新年：著新衫，講恭喜說話。

steps.en: Mid-Autumn: we eat mooncakes and see the moon.
Christmas: we sing songs and open presents.
Birthday: we sing, blow candles and eat cake.
steps.zh: 生日：唱歌，吹蠟燭，食蛋糕。

steps.en: Festivals are for being with family.
steps.zh: 過節就係同屋企人一齊。
